source_attributes.DEPOSIT_SUMMARY: Exploration by Indiana Resources Ltd. in 2022, established the presence of significant REE values in the regolith near the Minos Gold Prospect, as part of their Central Gawler Project tenements.  Assays confirmed widespread REE mineralisation, with intersections up to 76m thick recording high total REE (TREO) and magnet REE (MREO) values. The source of the REE has not been identified, however as the REE mineralisation is hosted in regolith and weathered saprolite/clays it is likely associated with the weathering of the alkaline Hiltaba Granite and gneissic basement rocks of the Gawler Craton.

stream sediment sampling returned heavy mineral contents high in rare earths. Heavy mineral fraction ~38% of the total, with zircon content to 1.6-8.6 %, TIO2 content 1.5 to 8.9%. REE of yttrium 100 ppm, cerium 800 ppm, and lanthanum at 600 ppm.
